flashcard_questions.q: Fuels formed over millions of years from the remains of dead organisms, including coal, oil and natural gas.
Burning a fuel in a plentiful supply of oxygen, producing only carbon dioxide and water.
Burning a fuel in a limited supply of oxygen, producing carbon monoxide, particulates (soot) and water instead of just carbon dioxide and water.

flashcard_questions.a: A colourless, odourless, toxic gas produced by incomplete combustion of hydrocarbon fuels.
The protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen around the body.
